# logcut v0.1.0

`logcut` is the first Rust release of the Bash `quiet-run` command used by `yamabiko-flow-blocks`.

## Platform

- Linux x86_64
- GNU libc target: `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`

## Main features

- Suppresses successful command output and prints a concise `PASS` result.
- Preserves the original command exit code.
- Prints profile-specific summaries when commands fail.
- Retains the full log on failure and removes it on success.
- Supports the profiles provided by the original `quiet-run` implementation.

## Install

```bash
tar -xzf logcut-v0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
install -m 0755 logcut ~/.local/bin/logcut
~/.local/bin/logcut true
```

Verify the downloaded archive before extracting it:

```bash
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
```

## Out of scope

This release does not include macOS, Windows, ARM64, package-manager distribution, code signing, crates.io publication, or automatic updates.
